subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the production of milk in 4 states in 2010 and 2011.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c90f1f7106422111eff53e24f7ae997754c3996c47e8d0ae862558d0e6261ac.png] 

The difference between the average production (in thousand tonnes) for all state in both years is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total production in 2010 = 30 + 25 + 50 + 55 = 160

Average production in 2010 = 160 / 4 = 40

Production in 2011 (in thousand tonnes):

Total production in 2011 = 40 + 50 + 45 + 50 = 185

Average production in 2011 = 185 / 4 = 46.25

Difference in average production = 46.25 - 40 = 6.25

**∴ The difference between the average production for all states in 2010 and 2011 is 6.25 thousand tonnes.**
